name: spreadsheetReadCsv
description: Creates a new spreadsheet workbook from a CSV file. The file is parsed into a single sheet (named Sheet1) with one row per line; quoted fields, escaped quotes and embedded delimiters/newlines are honoured. The fluent member form fromCsv(csvText, delimiter) instead replaces the active sheet's cells from an in-memory CSV string.

params.name: filePath
params.description: Path to the CSV file to read.

examples.title: Load a CSV file into a workbook
examples.description: Read the CSV to a workbook, then convert it to a query.
